title: 2026 AMC 8 Problem 9
statement: What is the value of this expression? \[ \frac{\sqrt{16\sqrt{81}}}{\sqrt{81\sqrt{16}}} \]

solutions.text: The numerator is \(\sqrt{16\sqrt{81}}\) \(=\sqrt{16\cdot9}\) \(=\sqrt{144}\) \(=12\). The denominator is \(\sqrt{81\sqrt{16}}\) \(=\sqrt{81\cdot4}\) \(=\sqrt{324}\) \(=18\). The value is \(\frac{12}{18}=\frac{2}{3}\).
hints: Evaluate the inner square roots first
The numerator is \(\sqrt{16\cdot9}\), and the denominator is \(\sqrt{81\cdot4}\)
